_about: FILI deck (like Community Chest). Drawn on FILI tiles 6, 18 and 28. Every card is a guess: the screenshots show no card text. Each card carries an El Filibusterismo fact. Effect types are defined in noli.json.

cards.text: Simoun the jeweler sells you a gem. Pay ₱100.
cards.fact: Simoun, a rich jeweler with dark glasses, is Ibarra in disguise, returned to take revenge.

cards.text: The steamer Tabo crawls up the Pasig. Move back 2 tiles.
cards.fact: El Filibusterismo opens on the slow, round steamer Tabo on the Pasig River, a symbol of the colonial government.

cards.text: Students win support for an academy of Spanish. Collect ₱100.
cards.fact: Students in the Fili campaign for an academy to teach Spanish, but the plan is stalled by the friars.

cards.text: Your book is printed with Valentin Ventura's help. Go to Ghent.
cards.fact: El Filibusterismo was printed in Ghent in 1891. Valentin Ventura paid for the printing when Rizal ran out of funds.

cards.text: Seditious posters appear at the university. Go to Dapitan Exile.
cards.fact: After anonymous posters appear, the students in the Fili are rounded up, Basilio among them.

cards.text: Isagani throws the lamp into the river. Keep this card to leave Dapitan Exile.
cards.fact: Isagani grabs Simoun's bomb lamp at the wedding feast and throws it into the river, saving the guests.

cards.text: Kabesang Tales loses his land. Pay ₱50.
cards.fact: Kabesang Tales clears his land only to have friars claim it, and he becomes the bandit Matanglawin.
Basilio, Sisa's son, studies medicine with Capitan Tiago's support.

cards.text: A wedding feast in Binondo. Go to Fili: Binondo.
cards.fact: Paulita Gomez and Juanito Pelaez's wedding feast is held in Capitan Tiago's former house, where Simoun sets his lamp.

cards.text: Father Florentino hears Simoun's last confession. Collect ₱20 from every player.
cards.fact: The Fili ends with Simoun dying at Father Florentino's house by the sea; the priest throws his treasure into the ocean.

cards.text: Juli seeks money to free her father. Pay each player ₱10.
cards.fact: Juli works as a servant to raise ransom for her father, Kabesang Tales.

cards.text: Sail home to the Philippines. Go to Hong Kong.
cards.fact: After the Fili came out, Rizal moved to Hong Kong in 1891 and worked as an eye doctor.
